question: I'm a graduate student who completed 15-513 (Introduction to Computer Systems) in a previous program. Does 15-513 count as equivalent to 15-213 for CS undergraduate prerequisite purposes?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-513 is listed as an equivalent of 15-213 in the course catalog. They are considered the same course for prerequisite and curriculum purposes. A student who completed 15-513 satisfies any requirement or prerequisite that lists 15-213.
reasoning_type: Course equivalence identification from anti-req/equiv listings
common_mistake: Treating different course numbers as entirely distinct when the university lists them as equivalents; not checking the equivalence listing in the course catalog
needs_verification: Confirm 15-513 is listed as equivalent to 15-213 in the CMU course catalog
Confirm whether 15-513 is open to undergraduates (noted in the catalog: 15-213 is not open to graduate students; 15-513 is the grad version)
Confirm the specific contexts in which the equivalence applies (prereqs vs. graduation requirements)
